description: Amazon Macie classification job is paused, cancelled or reports execution errors
rationale: An explicit status of PAUSED, USER_PAUSED, CANCELLED or lastRunErrorStatus=ERROR requires review. An error does not prove sensitive data was exposed, and absence of job activity is handled independently.
remediation: Inspect job ID, status, error code, target buckets, IAM/KMS access and schedule. Resume or re-create the job as appropriate.
